module: Editor debug window (Window > Debug > Extensions Debug menu) that lists the loaded Lua extensions (extensions.getLoadedExtensionsNames()) as an imgui tree. Each extension expands to recursively show the content of its table (imguiUtils.addRecursiveTreeTable). Useful to a modder to inspect the state of an extension live.
notes: The "Filters" checkbox is displayed but the filtering by type is commented out in the code: checking the box simply hides the detailed tree of each extension (nothing is displayed inside the nodes).
The checkboxes funCheck/numCheck/strCheck/cdataCheck/boolCheck/tblCheck are declared but never used.

onEditorGui.desc: Draws the "Extensions Debug Window": Filters checkbox then one tree node per loaded extension, with the recursive content of extensions[name] when Filters is unchecked.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called when the editor is initialized: registers the "extensionsDebug" window and the "Extensions Debug" menu entry (Debug group).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is loaded; does nothing here.
